a.lede: Googlebooks represent a huge upgrade over Chromebooks, but the older devices still have their place.
a.title: Are Chromebooks still worth buying after the Googlebooks release?

b.lede: Google attempted to take its Chromebook platform upscale with Googlebooks. But the timing could not have been worse. Phone support at launch is extremely limited, and most people use Android phones and Chromebooks because they’re cheap.
b.title: Googlebooks are as poorly timed as Valve’s Steam Machine, and may suffer a similar fate
